experiment: Lazily build per-shape property lookup indexes for long shapes
decision: reject and remove: repeated long-shape reads improve, but startup max RSS rises by about 4.2 MiB even for an empty process; no fixture-level result justifies this global memory cost

steady_state.cjs_inherited_read: 1,000,000 reads per process, matched loop control, three process replicates

measurement.interpretation: The index speeds repeated lookups on shapes with at least 32 properties but is also built during startup lookups of builtin shapes. First-use break-even on ordinary fixture sites and fixture-level score/RSS remain unqualified.

next_candidate: Evaluate inherited prototype-holder or primitive-receiver site caches first; these can remove hot searches without persistent indexes on every long shape.
